note: Mel publishes no fitting menu, no durations and no prices. Every duration and every price below is ours, not hers (decision #490), and each carries the proposed chip.

types.name: Quad fitting
types.blurb: Both feet measured standing, boot tried on the plate you would actually skate, laces and toe stop set before you leave.
bring: Your current skates if you have a pair

types.name: Ice boot fitting + heat-mould
types.blurb: Measured on the Brannock, sized to Aura's own suggested size, then baked and moulded to your foot while you wear it.
bring: Your blades if you already own them

types.name: Kids fitting
types.blurb: Growing feet, so we size for now and tell you honestly how long it will last. Adjustable options shown alongside.

types.name: Video consult
types.blurb: For skaters outside Gauteng. You trace and measure both feet on camera with us, we size the brand you want and send the result in writing.
bring: A sheet of paper, a pen and a tape measure
A wall and a hard floor

services.name: Heat-mould & fit in store
services.blurb: A foot-in-boot custom mould. Mel's own product page says these boots must be heat moulded and to phone the shop for it, so the service is real; the price here is ours.

services.name: Mail-in heat-mould
services.blurb: A pre-ship bake before the boot leaves us. Whether Mel offers a mail-in bake at all is an open question for the call.

promise.text: Measure both feet standing. Try the boot on the plate or blade you would actually skate. Adjust before you leave — lacing, toe stop, heel lift.

cancellation.text: Move or cancel a fitting up to 24 hours before, by WhatsApp, at no charge; after that the fitting fee is due.

availability.note: Mel publishes by-appointment hours only. Nothing in this demo suggests the shop can be visited without booking first; that is another shop's practice, not hers.
